parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs from ChEMBL. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno to require canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mesh_heading, and first_approval. Deduplicate rows on the output columns. Sort by first_approval descending, then by chembl_id ascending.
